summary: Neo-noir bullet-time shooter series by Remedy and Rockstar, with an upcoming Remedy remake bundle tracked separately as unreleased.

entries.title: Max Payne

primary.why: The Windows original is the highest-fidelity and most preservation-friendly route; later console/mobile ports vary in presentation and control compromises.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release via Steam or another PC storefront, applying widescreen/audio/compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Upcoming remake is tracked separately and should not replace this original-entry analysis until released.

entries.title: Max Payne 3

primary.why: Max Payne 3 shipped on PS3, Xbox 360, Windows, and OS X; Windows is the highest-fidelity and best-supported current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches; document Rockstar account/launcher state if required.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document launcher/account and multiplayer availability state.
